entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  distance to EMA20 = +5.29% -> -32 (weight 1.8) - Price 103.53 vs EMA20 98.33
  RSI 1h = 38.1 -> +20 (weight 2.0) - Neutral momentum zone
  Bollinger position = 65% of band -> -25 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  resistance proximity = 39.8% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  RSI divergence (1h) = bearish -> -17 (weight 1.3) - strength 48/100
  volume = 0.52x average -> -20 (weight 1.0) - Thin participation - moves made on low volume are less reliable
  RSI daily = 62.3 -> -9 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone

  weighted sum / total weight (9.5) = -7.8 -> WAIT
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
